summary: Applies a 3D affine transform to a 3-vector: this is a 3x3 matrix of doubles (row-major, offsets +0x0..+0x40) with a2 the translation vector and a3 the input vector. Computes v4 = row1 dot a3 and v6 = row2 dot a3, then writes a4[0] = row0 dot a3 + a2[0], a4[1] = v4 + a2[1], a4[2] = v6 + a2[2], i.e. a4 = this*a3 + a2. Returns the translation vector pointer a2. Pure coordinate-transform helper with no branches, globals, or callees; structural twin of Matrix3x3VectorMultiply with translation added; on frame path and used by vehicle physics setup/integration callers.

local_names.a2: translation vector added to the rotated result
local_names.v4: row 1 dot product of the matrix with a3
local_names.v6: row 2 dot product of the matrix with a3

operations.description: v4 = this[3]*a3[0] + this[4]*a3[1] + this[5]*a3[2] (matrix row 1, offsets +0x18/+0x20/+0x28).
Set result = a2 (the return value is the translation vector pointer).
v6 = this[6]*a3[0] + this[7]*a3[1] + this[8]*a3[2] (matrix row 2, offsets +0x30/+0x38/+0x40).
a4[0] = this[0]*a3[0] + this[1]*a3[1] + this[2]*a3[2] + a2[0] (matrix row 0, offsets +0x0/+0x8/+0x10, plus translation x).
a4[1] = v4 + a2[1] (row 1 result plus translation y).
a4[2] = v6 + a2[2] (row 2 result plus translation z).
Return result (the translation vector pointer a2).
